title: Provider credential week
subtitle: Fictional demo or operator records. Read-only record checks.

sections.title: Site readiness
sections.sql: select appointment,provider,site,status,gaps,findings from site_readiness order by appointment

sections.title: Recorded checks
sections.sql: select code,provider,kind,expires_on,checked_on,verification_result,verifier from credential_register order by provider,kind

sections.sql: select appointment,provider,site,kind,finding from appointment_checks where status<>'ended' order by appointment,kind
